description: Export list. Export all items from a completed list. The list must have status "completed" before export. Credits are charged per record. Requires user approval and confirmed=true before changes or credit use. Writes are never retried automatically.

anchor.description: Row anchor. Property lists default to person so exports return property-owner contact rows. Use property for property-only rows.

confirmed.description: Set true only after the user approves this change or credit use.

name: dealmachine_post_lists_list_id_export
